V0_inventor_I10.note: Inventor I-10 as proposed: no motor; the rider snatches a 0.25 m ring at every pass and re-tosses (analytic, see captureTable)

V1_lead_only.note: Lead glider that never perches (front-chase glider)

V2_chosen.note: Chosen: leapfrog lead glider, perch every hop, pass shot every 2nd hop, active hoop snatch at the end

V4_no_holster_bank.note: On-board 3.7 Wh only (no holster bank recharge)

V5_light_100g.note: 100 g airframe (smaller battery, no periscope), KE cap 17 m/s

V6_wide_lens_64.note: 64° lens (round-2 inventor action-cam class) instead of 36°

V7_folded_pod_perch.note: Perch with wings folded (pod), no wing-tip outriggers

V8_passive_feather.note: Wings feathered nose-down only (no active sign switching)

V9_no_adaptive_gap.note: Fixed 48 m lead target (no subject-size-aware gap)
